headline: Executive order on probationary periods for federal workers, the trial period new employees serve before their jobs become more secure.
what_it_does: This executive order deals with probationary periods in the federal government. A probationary period is a trial time when new federal employees can be removed more easily than permanent workers. Only the title was available, so the specific rules, steps, or changes the order makes cannot be described here.

who_it_affects.group: New federal employees serving a probationary period
who_it_affects.how: The order addresses the trial period these workers must complete before gaining fuller job protections.
The order likely concerns how managers review and decide on employees during their probationary period.
